form.label: PSIMS / SureView Enterprise Signal Flow Health - v5.1 HOSTFIX
form.description: HOSTFIX-20260815: verified active-active hosts are GPVWA00A0001, GPVWA00A0002, GRVWA00A0001, and GRVWA00A0002. Uses a shared same-time-of-day five-day baseline, fixed host scoping with hostname normalization, seeded no-data detection, DMP Event 23 loss monitoring, freshness checks, host discovery, and diagnostic drill-downs. DB queue telemetry remains deferred until schema confirmation.

search.query: index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" earliest=-5d@d latest=now | eval host=upper(mvindex(split(host,"."),0)) | search host IN ("GPVWA00A0001","GPVWA00A0002","GRVWA00A0001","GRVWA00A0002") | eval Day=relative_time(_time,"@d"), Today=relative_time(now(),"@d"), SecIntoDay=_time-Day, Cutoff=now()-Today | eval InSameTime=if(Day=Today OR SecIntoDay<=Cutoff,1,0) | stats count(eval(InSameTime=1)) as Total count(eval(InSameTime=1 AND EventCode=23 AND Type=1)) as E23 count(eval(InSameTime=1 AND EventCode=33)) as E33 count(eval(InSameTime=1 AND EventCode=34)) as E34 count(eval(InSameTime=1 AND EventCode=55)) as E55 max(eval(if(InSameTime=1,_time,null()))) as LastSeen count as FullDayEvents by host Day | eval DataPresent=if(FullDayEvents>0,1,0) | append [ | makeresults count=24 | streamstats count as n | eval host=case(n<=6,"GPVWA00A0001",n<=12,"GPVWA00A0002",n<=18,"GRVWA00A0001",true(),"GRVWA00A0002"), Offset=(n-1)%6 | eval Day=case(Offset=0,relative_time(now(),"@d"),Offset=1,relative_time(now(),"-1d@d"),Offset=2,relative_time(now(),"-2d@d"),Offset=3,relative_time(now(),"-3d@d"),Offset=4,relative_time(now(),"-4d@d"),true(),relative_time(now(),"-5d@d")), Total=0, E23=0, E33=0, E34=0, E55=0, DataPresent=0 | fields host Day Total E23 E33 E34 E55 DataPresent ] | stats sum(Total) as Total sum(E23) as E23 sum(E33) as E33 sum(E34) as E34 sum(E55) as E55 max(LastSeen) as LastSeen max(DataPresent) as DataPresent by host Day | eval Today=relative_time(now(),"@d"), IsToday=if(Day=Today,1,0)

| makeresults count=4 | streamstats count as n | eval host=case(n=1,"GPVWA00A0001",n=2,"GPVWA00A0002",n=3,"GRVWA00A0001",true(),"GRVWA00A0002"), LastSeen=null(), Total24h=0, DMP23_15m=0 | fields host LastSeen Total24h DMP23_15m | append [ search index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" earliest=-24h latest=now | eval host=upper(mvindex(split(host,"."),0)) | search host IN ("GPVWA00A0001","GPVWA00A0002","GRVWA00A0001","GRVWA00A0002") | stats count as Total24h latest(_time) as LastSeen count(eval(_time>=relative_time(now(),"-15m") AND EventCode=23 AND Type=1)) as DMP23_15m by host ] | stats max(LastSeen) as LastSeen max(Total24h) as Total24h max(DMP23_15m) as DMP23_15m by host | eval AgeMin=if(isnull(LastSeen),999999,round((now()-LastSeen)/60,1)), LastSeenText=if(isnull(LastSeen),"NO DATA IN 24H",strftime(LastSeen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))

| search host="$host_tok$" | eval Priority=case(DMP23_15m>0,5,isnull(LastSeen),5,AgeMin>=$fresh_crit$,5,AgeMin>=$fresh_warn$,3,true(),1) | eventstats max(Priority) as WorstPriority | where Priority=WorstPriority | stats values(host) as AffectedHosts max(AgeMin) as MaxAge sum(DMP23_15m) as DMP23_15m by WorstPriority | eval Health=case(WorstPriority=5 AND DMP23_15m>0,"CRITICAL - DMP SIGNAL LOSS",WorstPriority=5,"CRITICAL - HOST SILENT",WorstPriority=3,"WARNING - HOST STALE",true(),"NORMAL") | eval Result=Health." | ".mvjoin(AffectedHosts,",") | fields Result

| search host="$host_tok$" | stats sum(Total) as Events sum(DataPresent) as HostsWithData by Day IsToday | eventstats avg(eval(if(IsToday=0,Events,null()))) as FiveDayAvg sum(eval(if(IsToday=0,HostsWithData,0))) as BaselineHostDays | where IsToday=1 | eval ExpectedHostDays=if("$host_tok$"="*",20,5), Percent=if(FiveDayAvg>0,round(((Events-FiveDayAvg)/FiveDayAvg)*100,1),null()) | eval Result=case(BaselineHostDays<ExpectedHostDays,"BASELINE INCOMPLETE | ".BaselineHostDays."/".ExpectedHostDays." host-days",isnull(Percent),"UNKNOWN",true(),tostring(Percent)."% | Now=".Events." | Avg=".round(FiveDayAvg,0)) | fields Result

single.title: Worst Host: Minutes Since Last Activity

search.query: | search host="$host_tok$" | stats max(AgeMin) as Minutes | eval Minutes=if(Minutes=999999,"NO DATA IN 24H",Minutes)
| stats count(eval(isnotnull(LastSeen))) as ActiveHosts | eval Result=ActiveHosts." / 4" | fields Result

single.title: DMP Signal Loss - Event 23 Type 1 (15 min)

search.query: | search host="$host_tok$" | stats sum(DMP23_15m) as LossEvents | eval Result=if(LossEvents>0,"CRITICAL | ".LossEvents." DMP loss event(s)","NORMAL | 0 DMP loss events") | fields Result

| search host="$host_tok$" | stats sum(E33) as Events sum(DataPresent) as HostsWithData by Day IsToday | eventstats avg(eval(if(IsToday=0,Events,null()))) as Base sum(eval(if(IsToday=0,HostsWithData,0))) as BaselineHostDays | where IsToday=1 | eval ExpectedHostDays=if("$host_tok$"="*",20,5), Pct=if(Base>0,round(((Events-Base)/Base)*100,1),null()) | eval Status=case(BaselineHostDays<ExpectedHostDays,"BASELINE INCOMPLETE",isnull(Pct),"UNKNOWN",Pct>=$crit_pct$,"CRITICAL",Pct>=$warn_pct$,"WARNING",true(),"NORMAL") | eval Result=Status." | ".coalesce(tostring(Pct),"N/A")."% | Now=".Events." | Avg=".round(Base,0) | fields Result

| search host="$host_tok$" | stats sum(E34) as Events sum(DataPresent) as HostsWithData by Day IsToday | eventstats avg(eval(if(IsToday=0,Events,null()))) as Base sum(eval(if(IsToday=0,HostsWithData,0))) as BaselineHostDays | where IsToday=1 | eval ExpectedHostDays=if("$host_tok$"="*",20,5), Pct=if(Base>0,round(((Events-Base)/Base)*100,1),null()) | eval Status=case(BaselineHostDays<ExpectedHostDays,"BASELINE INCOMPLETE",isnull(Pct),"UNKNOWN",Pct>=$crit_pct$,"CRITICAL",Pct>=$warn_pct$,"WARNING",true(),"NORMAL") | eval Result=Status." | ".coalesce(tostring(Pct),"N/A")."% | Now=".Events." | Avg=".round(Base,0) | fields Result

| search host="$host_tok$" | stats sum(E55) as Events sum(DataPresent) as HostsWithData by Day IsToday | eventstats avg(eval(if(IsToday=0,Events,null()))) as Base sum(eval(if(IsToday=0,HostsWithData,0))) as BaselineHostDays | where IsToday=1 | eval ExpectedHostDays=if("$host_tok$"="*",20,5), Pct=if(Base>0,round(((Events-Base)/Base)*100,1),null()) | eval Status=case(BaselineHostDays<ExpectedHostDays,"BASELINE INCOMPLETE",isnull(Pct),"UNKNOWN",Pct>=$crit_pct$,"CRITICAL",Pct>=$warn_pct$,"WARNING",true(),"NORMAL") | eval Result=Status." | ".coalesce(tostring(Pct),"N/A")."% | Now=".Events." | Avg=".round(Base,0) | fields Result

table.title: Today vs Previous 5 Days at the Same Time of Day

search.query: | search host="$host_tok$" | stats sum(Total) as Total sum(E23) as Event23 sum(E33) as Event33 sum(E34) as Event34 sum(E55) as Event55 sum(DataPresent) as HostsWithData by Day IsToday | eventstats avg(eval(if(IsToday=0,Total,null()))) as AvgTotal avg(eval(if(IsToday=0,Event33,null()))) as Avg33 avg(eval(if(IsToday=0,Event34,null()))) as Avg34 avg(eval(if(IsToday=0,Event55,null()))) as Avg55 | eval Date=strftime(Day,"%Y-%m-%d"), TotalVarPct=if(AvgTotal>0,round(((Total-AvgTotal)/AvgTotal)*100,1),null()), E33VarPct=if(Avg33>0,round(((Event33-Avg33)/Avg33)*100,1),null()), E34VarPct=if(Avg34>0,round(((Event34-Avg34)/Avg34)*100,1),null()), E55VarPct=if(Avg55>0,round(((Event55-Avg55)/Avg55)*100,1),null()) | eval ExpectedHosts=if("$host_tok$"="*",4,1), Status=if(IsToday=1,case(HostsWithData<ExpectedHosts,"CRITICAL - HOST DATA MISSING",Event23>0,"CRITICAL - DMP SIGNAL LOSS",TotalVarPct>=$crit_pct$ OR E55VarPct>=$crit_pct$,"CRITICAL",TotalVarPct>=$warn_pct$ OR E55VarPct>=$warn_pct$,"WARNING",true(),"NORMAL"),"BASELINE DAY") | table Date IsToday HostsWithData Total AvgTotal TotalVarPct Event23 Event33 Avg33 E33VarPct Event34 Avg34 E34VarPct Event55 Avg55 E55VarPct Status | sort - Date

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" (EventCode=33 OR EventCode=34) | eval host=upper(mvindex(split(host,"."),0)) | search host IN ("GPVWA00A0001","GPVWA00A0002","GRVWA00A0001","GRVWA00A0002") | search host="$host_tok$" | eval Flow=case(EventCode=33,"Event 33",EventCode=34,"Event 34") | timechart span=5m count by Flow

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" EventCode=55 | eval host=upper(mvindex(split(host,"."),0)) | search host IN ("GPVWA00A0001","GPVWA00A0002","GRVWA00A0001","GRVWA00A0002") | search host="$host_tok$" | timechart span=5m count as Event55

chart.title: DMP Signal Loss Event 23 Type 1 Trend

search.query: index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" EventCode=23 Type=1 | eval host=upper(mvindex(split(host,"."),0)) | search host IN ("GPVWA00A0001","GPVWA00A0002","GRVWA00A0001","GRVWA00A0002") | search host="$host_tok$" | timechart span=5m count as DMP_Loss_Events

table.title: Enterprise Host Health Matrix - Silent Hosts Are Retained

search.query: | search host="$host_tok$" | eval Health=case(DMP23_15m>0,"CRITICAL - DMP SIGNAL LOSS",isnull(LastSeen),"CRITICAL - NO DATA IN 24H",AgeMin>=$fresh_crit$,"CRITICAL - NO ACTIVITY",AgeMin>=$fresh_warn$,"WARNING - STALE",true(),"ACTIVE") | table host Health AgeMin Total24h DMP23_15m LastSeenText | sort host

table.title: Baseline Alert Candidates - Rows Only When Attention Is Required

search.query: | search host="$host_tok$" | eventstats avg(eval(if(IsToday=0,Total,null()))) as AvgTotal avg(eval(if(IsToday=0,E55,null()))) as Avg55 sum(eval(if(IsToday=0,DataPresent,0))) as BaselineDaysWithData by host | where IsToday=1 | eval TotalVarPct=if(AvgTotal>0,round(((Total-AvgTotal)/AvgTotal)*100,1),null()), E55VarPct=if(Avg55>0,round(((E55-Avg55)/Avg55)*100,1),null()) | eval Trigger=case(E23>0,"CRITICAL: DMP SIGNAL LOSS EVENT 23",BaselineDaysWithData<5,"WARNING: FIVE-DAY BASELINE INCOMPLETE",TotalVarPct>=$crit_pct$,"CRITICAL: TOTAL VOLUME ABOVE BASELINE",E55VarPct>=$crit_pct$,"CRITICAL: EVENT 55 ABOVE BASELINE",TotalVarPct<=-$crit_pct$,"CRITICAL: TOTAL VOLUME BELOW BASELINE",TotalVarPct>=$warn_pct$,"WARNING: TOTAL VOLUME ABOVE BASELINE",E55VarPct>=$warn_pct$,"WARNING: EVENT 55 ABOVE BASELINE",TotalVarPct<=-$warn_pct$,"WARNING: TOTAL VOLUME BELOW BASELINE",true(),null()) | where isnotnull(Trigger) | eval LastSeenText=if(isnull(LastSeen),"NO EVENTS TODAY",strftime(LastSeen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")) | table host Trigger Total AvgTotal TotalVarPct E23 E33 E34 E55 Avg55 E55VarPct BaselineDaysWithData LastSeenText | sort Trigger host

table.title: DMP Signal Loss Details - Event 23 Type 1

search.query: index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" EventCode=23 Type=1 | eval RawHost=host, host=upper(mvindex(split(host,"."),0)) | search host IN ("GPVWA00A0001","GPVWA00A0002","GRVWA00A0001","GRVWA00A0002") | search host="$host_tok$" | eval EventTime=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table EventTime host RawHost EventCode Type Message | sort - EventTime

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" | eval host=upper(mvindex(split(host,"."),0)) | search host IN ("GPVWA00A0001","GPVWA00A0002","GRVWA00A0001","GRVWA00A0002") | search host="$host_tok$" | search (EventCode=55 OR Message="*invalid_signal*" OR Message="*Failed to decode signal*" OR Message="*Timeout*" OR Message="*exception*" OR Message="*failed*" OR Message="*error*") | eval EventTime=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table EventTime host EventCode Type Message | sort - EventTime

table.title: CloudLink Host Discovery - Compare Raw and Normalized Hostnames

search.query: index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" | eval RawHost=host, NormalizedHost=upper(mvindex(split(host,"."),0)) | stats count as Events latest(_time) as LastSeen by RawHost NormalizedHost | eval Verified=if(in(NormalizedHost,"GPVWA00A0001","GPVWA00A0002","GRVWA00A0001","GRVWA00A0002"),"YES","NO"), LastSeen=strftime(LastSeen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table RawHost NormalizedHost Verified Events LastSeen | sort - Events

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" | eval RawHost=host, host=upper(mvindex(split(host,"."),0)) | search host IN ("GPVWA00A0001","GPVWA00A0002","GRVWA00A0001","GRVWA00A0002") | search host="$host_tok$" | eval EventTime=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval Meaning=case(EventCode=23 AND Type=1,"DMP Signal Loss",EventCode=33,"Observed Event 33",EventCode=34,"Observed Event 34",EventCode=41,"Tunnel Candidate 41",EventCode=48,"Tunnel Candidate 48",EventCode=49,"Tunnel Candidate 49",EventCode=55,"Review Event 55",true(),"Other") | table EventTime host RawHost EventCode Meaning Type Message | sort - EventTime

html.p: Corrected baseline: The Today field is recreated after aggregation, and the shared baseline always includes four hosts across today plus the previous five calendar days at the same time of day.

Host safety: Hostnames are normalized to uppercase short names. All operational searches remain restricted to the four verified hosts. The discovery table shows the original indexed host value for comparison.
No-data safety: All four hosts are seeded before freshness calculation. A silent host remains visible and can make overall health critical.
DMP monitoring: EventCode 23 with Type 1 is treated as the confirmed DMP signal-loss condition and receives its own health card, trend, detail table, and alert search.
Provisional semantics: Events 33, 34, and 55 remain observed diagnostic event IDs until their exact vendor meanings are formally validated. The 33/34 count difference is not treated as queue depth.
Phase 2 - DB queue: Queue depth, oldest pending signal, enqueue/drain rates, last processed signal, and sustained non-draining detection will be added after the production queue schema is confirmed.
